audio_render_fidelity_finding.question: can AUDIO_RENDER attest DRAFT synthetic narration without claiming it is production audio?
evidence: the adapter raises AUDIO_NOT_PRODUCTION_READY for any state other than PRODUCTION_READY, so draft narration would have to either claim PRODUCTION_READY (a lie) or omit state (attesting nothing)
the payload has no fidelity, source_class or mix_kind field: nothing distinguishes synthetic speech from a final mix
defects are attributed to sound_music_director, while a draft narration render would be produced by generation_supervisor
SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE_KINDS is CAMERA_QUALITY, GENERATION_RESULT, EDIT_QC_HANDOFF, AUDIO_RENDER, STORY_VALIDATION — there is no narration or proxy kind
EVIDENCE_CLASSES is DETERMINISTIC | SPECIALIST | HUMAN | UNVERIFIED, which is a verification-provenance axis and cannot express proxy versus real fidelity
audio_render_fidelity_finding.recommendation: add a distinct typed evidence kind, DRAFT_SYNTHETIC_NARRATION, with its own QC adapter — the same way CAMERA_QUALITY and AUDIO_RENDER are separate kinds. Do NOT overload AUDIO_RENDER; overloading it is how proxy audio would eventually be mistaken for a production mix.
audio_render_fidelity_finding.consequence: this blocks the narration attestation path independently of the missing provider. Both must be closed for gate 8 DRAFT to move.
